description.en: Nagano Prefecture is a landlocked prefecture of Japan located in the Chūbu region of Honshu. It has a population of 2,007,682 as of 1 July 2023 and a geographic area of 13,561.56 square kilometres .

description.en: Aichi Prefecture is a prefecture of Japan located in the Chūbu region of Honshū. Aichi Prefecture has a population of 7,461,111 and a geographic area of 5,172.92 square kilometres with a population density of 1,442 inhabitants per square kilometre .

description.en: Toyama Prefecture is a prefecture of Japan located in the Chūbu region of Honshu. Toyama Prefecture has a population of 993,848 and has a geographic area of 4,247.61 km2 .

description.en: Shizuoka Prefecture is a prefecture of Japan located in the Chūbu region of Honshu. As of October 2026, Shizuoka Prefecture has a population of 3,435,185 and has a geographic area of 7,777.42 km2 .

description.en: The Chūbu region , Central region, or Central Japan is a large and diverse region in the middle of Honshū, Japan's main island. In a wide, classical definition, it encompasses nine prefectures : Aichi, Fukui, Gifu, Ishikawa, Nagano, Niigata, Shizuoka, Toyama, and Yamanashi.

description.en: Gifu Prefecture is a prefecture of Japan located in the Chūbu region of Honshu. Gifu Prefecture has a population of 2,040,000 and has a geographic area of 10,621 square kilometres .
